prompt.text:
Implement a local media-console model in `Solution.java`, with no I/O. Provide immutable nested class `Clip` with constructor `Clip(String id, String title, String creator)` and getters, plus nested class `Console`. Expose `Console createConsole(List<Clip> catalog)`, `List<Clip> search(Console console, String term)`, `int getLevel(Console console)`, `void setLevel(Console console, int level)`, `boolean select(Console console, String clipId)`, and `boolean isActive(Console console)`. Clip fields are trimmed and must be non-null and non-blank. Catalog ids must be unique and case-sensitive. Invalid construction arguments throw `IllegalArgumentException`. The console begins at level 50 and inactive. Search trims its non-null term, matches title or creator ignoring case, and returns matches in catalog order; an empty term matches every clip. The result is an unmodifiable snapshot. Levels outside 0 through 100 are invalid. Selecting an existing id activates the console and returns true; a missing id returns false without changing current state. Null consoles and null ids are invalid. The console must defensively copy the catalog, while immutable clips may safely be shared.
